title: pastinaca orsinii
intro: Pastinaca orsinii, commonly known as Sicilian celery, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region, valued for its edible stalks and roots, as well as its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Pastinaca orsinii include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Pastinaca orsinii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, diuretic, and antispasmodic effects.
